Sukesh Chandrashekhar gets 8-year jail term for impersonation

Conman Sukesh Chandrashekhar has been sentenced to eight years of rigorous imprisonment. He was found guilty of attempting to influence the bail process by impersonating himself as a Supreme Court judge. The court also imposed a fine on him. The case involved allegations of him trying to secure bail for himself by impersonating a judge.
